capabilities: switch to a note's existing tab instead of opening a duplicate
configure the search scope across tab groups and windows
scroll to headings and blocks when switching via link
close a new empty tab before it is drawn
respect requests from plugins not to focus the note
extras: Beta releases can be installed via BRAT (ChrisDavison/focus-existing-tab). The README warns the plugin wraps an undocumented Obsidian internal method, so a future Obsidian release could break it.
intentEvidence: Mononote has the same goal. It reacts after a tab has become active, so the duplicate tab is opened first and then closed
problem: Obsidian opens a second copy of a note that is already open in a tab, which leaves duplicate tabs scattered across splits and windows.

relations.evidence: Mononote has the same goal. It reacts after a tab has become active
Opener also switched to existing tabs, and opened PDFs in your system's default app

summary: Tab manager that switches to a note's already-open tab instead of opening a duplicate, including tabs in other vault windows.
